Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T14:05:00Z
Subject: Follow-up: Private VPC architecture review (next steps)

Hi David —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Really appreciate you walking through ACME Health's latency and data isolation requirements — that context was helpful. As discussed, the next step is a technical architecture review focused on Private/VPC deployment (networking, KMS, audit logs, and on-prem constraints).

Proposed agenda (30-45 min):
- Quick recap (5 min)
- VPC & network topology options (15 min)
- Auth/KMS & key management integration (10 min)
- Logging/audit and retention controls (5 min)
- Q&A & next steps (5-10 min)

Who should attend from your side: engineering lead, cloud/network engineer, and security/compliance owner. From our side I'll bring Alex (solutions engineer) and Dev (infrastructure engineer).

Time options (all PT):
- Tue 2026-10-06 10:00-10:45am PT
- Tue 2026-10-06 2:00-2:45pm PT
- Thu 2026-10-08 10:00-10:45am PT

If none of those work, you can pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min

I've attached a short draft of a VPC topology that we can iterate on during the call (ACME_VPC_draft.pdf).

Next steps: confirm attendees + preferred slot and I'll send an invite with a working agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks David.

Confirming Thu 2026-10-08 10:00-10:45am PT. I'll send a calendar invite in a minute and include the agenda + connection details. Short answers to your prep questions:
- Network connectivity: for most customers we support either IPsec VPN or cloud provider interconnect (AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute). We'll outline the firewall ports and expected CIDR ranges in the invite.
- KMS: yes — customer-managed KMS is supported for Private deployments. We'll have our infra lead (Dev) cover the KMS flow and key rotation options in the review.

Attendees from Redwood: Marissa (AE), Alex (solutions engineer), Dev (infra engineer). Please add your security lead when you have them and let us know if you want any specific artifacts reviewed (diagram, SOC2 evidence, key policies).

Link to the draft topology and supporting docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_example_vpc_docs

Marissa
